_comment: Reviewed licence exceptions. Every entry is DEV/BUILD-TIME ONLY: the Worker has zero runtime dependencies (npm ls --omit=dev is empty). Status of every entry is NEEDS REVIEW until counsel or the owners sign it off. Matching is by package name and exact licence string.

exceptions.name: argparse
exceptions.reason: Permissive PSF-style licence, transitive dev tooling dependency, not distributed.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.reason: Browser-support data used by build tooling. Attribution licence, not distributed.

exceptions.name: lightningcss
exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of vite (test tooling). File-level copyleft, unmodified, not distributed.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of lightningcss. Same reasoning.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of lightningcss (CI runner). Same reasoning.

exceptions.name: spdx-exceptions
exceptions.reason: Data package pulled in by licence tooling. Not distributed.

exceptions.name: spdx-ranges
exceptions.reason: Data package pulled in by licence tooling. Not distributed.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-wasm32
exceptions.reason: Optional image library pulled in by Wrangler/Miniflare local dev. LGPL libvips. Dynamically linked, unmodified, never deployed to the Worker.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-win32-x64
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of sharp for developer machines. Same reasoning.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-linux-x64
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of sharp for CI runners. Same reasoning.
